description: Abwasseranteil (kumuliert) im Gewässer ausgehend von kommunalen Kläranlagen in NRW (2020) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Landesamt für Natur, Umwelt und Klima Nordrhein-Westfalen. Municipal waste water shares in water bodies as at 31.12.2020: In order to be able to assess the influence of wastewater from municipal wastewater treatment plants (KA) on the status of the water bodies, the wastewater fraction of the municipal wastewater treatment plant was determined on the one hand based on the discharge characteristics of ... Coverage: Landesamt für Natur, Umwelt und Klima Nordrhein-Westfalen. The portal shows the English title as "Wastewater content (cumulative) in water from municipal wastewater treatment plants in North Rhine-Westphalia (2020)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Landesamt für Natur, Umwelt und Klima Nordrhein-Westfalen. Its keywords include Median des Abflusses 0, WRRL, Abwasseranteil, kommunale Kläranlagen, Kläranlagen, kommunal. The listing shows 2022-02-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/zero-2-0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
